newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes down against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes down against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at 8.2958 on Thursday from Wednesday's 8.2951 against the U.S. dollar with some banks actively buying dollars for their own use, traders said.
The weighted average price on Wednesday was 8.2953.
The yuan opened unchanged at an intraday high of 8.2951 and consolidated down for most of the session, hitting a low of 8.2960.
Trading was more active than Wednesday with most done at 8.2955, traders said.
Dealers said some banks were seen buying the dollar in the midsession, which pushed the yuan down to the 8.2960 level.
"The buying was believed to be for the banks' own use and won't be continuous," one dealer said.
He said the buying was not related to central bank intervention and the yuan could stand above 8.2960.
Dealers expected the yuan to move between 8.2950 and 8.2960 on Friday.
The yuan closed down at 6.8089 from 6.7850 against 100 Japanese yen and little changed at 1.0722 from 1.0721 against the Hong Kong dollar.
